title: Abstract normalization residue degree divisibility calculation
statement: theorem normalization_residue_degree_dvd_core {N V P D : Scheme.{u}} (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (p : P ⟶ V) [IsFinite p] (a : P ⟶ N) [QuasiCompact a] [QuasiSeparated a] (hEtale : Etale p) (hNorm : IsFinite a.fromNormalization) (j : D ⟶ N) (hD : IsRegular D) (hDi : IsIntegral D) (hj : IsEffectiveCartierCenter j) (O : N.Opens) (hcomp : ∀ z : N, z ∈ O ↔ z ∉ Set.range j) (η : D) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ) (x : a.normalization) (hx : a.fromNormalization x = j η) : letI := (a.fromNormalization.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra Module.finrank (N.residueField (a.fromNormalization x)) (a.normalization.residueField x) ∣ Nat.card G

proof.text: Localize at the generic Cartier point and identify the normalization stalk with the integral closure of the resulting DVR.
The generic finite etale algebra splits into Galois factors whose degrees divide the finite group order.
Apply the Galois DVR degree formula [L:K]=r*e*f to conclude that each residue degree f divides the group order.

mathlib_searches.query: residue degree divides Galois group order DVR
mathlib_searches.results: No complete scheme theorem; algebraic ramification ingredients only
